_comment: The heavy water plant (SPEC.md §16, MISSION-GUNNERSIDE.md): mission 4's map, in the same shape as data/map.json, made by a script from a sketch; the file is the truth from now on. rows are row-major: rows[r] is board row r, and character i in that row is the hex at axial q = rowQStart(r) + i. M58b (the operator's notes on the M58 draft; M58c the hall two hexes west, out of the crowd round the telephone line): the gorge wanders and is two deep where it narrows (a crossing two turns), three with the ice only in its middle stretch; the plant moved east, a thin shell of wall; the pipes are no longer ground; pine lanes on the plateau.
name: The heavy water plant at Vassdal
_dropRuns: SPEC.md §9, §16. Three runs from three sides over the plateau, their names on three edges: West in from the west edge over the pine woods (a man in the pines loses his first turn; the narrow west end of the gorge is close); North down from the top edge over the open middle (soft landings, prints wherever they go); East in from the east edge toward the road and the bridge (nearest the crossing and the way out, and the bridge post and the plateau patrol).

dropRuns.label: West run
dropRuns.description: In from the west over the pine woods: under the trees, and close to where the gorge narrows. A man who comes down in the pines loses his first turn.

dropRuns.label: North run
dropRuns.description: Down from the north over the open middle of the plateau: the softest landing on the map, and prints wherever the men go.

dropRuns.label: East run
dropRuns.description: In from the east toward the road and the bridge: the nearest to the crossing and the way out, and the nearest to the bridge post and the plateau patrol.

_enemies: SPEC.md §6, §16. Seven. Posts: the bridge post, one beside each end, each sweeping between the deck and the gorge; the gate guard by the main door. Patrols: the plateau patrol across the East run's ground to the road, the one that reads prints; the rim patrol along the gorge's north rim west of the bridge; the plant patrol along the railway to the duct; the road patrol on the road between the gate and the town. They set out on turn 2.
_reserve: SPEC.md §6, §16. Out of the barracks at Alarmed, over the bridge, to stand guard beside the ski trail. Never, once the telephone line is down (its kind's payoff).
_reinforcements: SPEC.md §6, §16. Up the road from Elvebyen off the south-east edge when the hall goes up (one squad on Normal, two on Hard, none on Easy; none once the telephone line is cut), across the bridge to posts on the way out; and a squad for a body found, to where it lay.
_objectives: SPEC.md §7, §16. `ringCharges` (M58e, art only) has the pen ring before the drop take in the charge points too. The cell hall is the primary: its footprint is the cells along the hall's back wall; its four charge points are the hall floor beside them, so a man on one when they go is in the kill radius. The duct at its west end and the main door at its east end are the ways in. The telephone line's junction box stands on its rock by the road under the gorge, a charge point either side; a scout can cut it there.
_exfil: SPEC.md §10, §16. The ski trail off the north-east corner of the plateau, three hexes down the east edge from the corner, open all night. exfilArt names its picture: two lines of ski tracks and a cairn.
_railway: SPEC.md §11, art only: the line drawn through the railway's hexes along the shelf, from the west edge to the duct. Its hexes are Railway ground (terrain.json), which is what the rules read.
_printedAs: SPEC.md §11, art only: the bridge's hexes are printed as the suspension bridge's deck over the gorge (theme.js `suspension`). Every rule still reads Bridge.
_places: SPEC.md §11. Art only. Placeholder names for the operator to reword (MISSION-GUNNERSIDE.md). The gorge's name in the village names' spaced capitals along it (M58b, the operator's: it did not read as a gorge).
